changes.summary: Academic Libraries was retired as an IPEDS survey component beginning in 2025-26.
The federal materials use sex, male, and female terminology; Another Gender is no longer collected.
The open-admissions screening question moved from IC to ADM.
Cost remains a separately versioned component spanning the Fall and Winter collection periods.
Section 1 collects consistent aid types across undergraduate categories, and IASG awards are included with Federal Pell Grant counts and amounts.
Admissions adds transfer-in reporting, expanded race/ethnicity and attendance-status detail, and waitlist, Early Decision, and Early Action elements when applicable.
The applicable 2025-26 forms use sex, male, and female terminology; non-binary/Another Gender fields are no longer collected.
